newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 10-mth foreign ship orders plunge.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 10-mth foreign ship orders plunge.

text.p: South Korean shipbuilding firms won foreign orders totalling 3.77 million gross tonnes during the first 10 months of this year, down 25.4 percent from 5.06 million gross tonnes a year earlier, the Korea Shipbuilders Association said on Monday.
The association said in a statement South Korean firms had backlog orders totalling 11.35 million gross tonnes at the end of October, compared with 13.26 million a year earlier.
